recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast composition featuring a black industrial flight case with metallic reinforced corners, filled with vinyl records, set against a solid black void. The typography is dominated by heavy, tightly-spaced sans-serif fonts in vibrant yellow.
coreVisualRelationships: The flight case acts as a central pedestal for the record sleeves.
The yellow text provides a stark, high-energy contrast against the black background.
The metallic hardware of the case adds a tactile, industrial texture to the clean digital layout.
coreInvariants: Metallic silver hardware on a black flight case

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The flight case is centered in the lower two-thirds of the frame, angled slightly to show depth.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The metallic latch and reinforced corners of the case provide the primary structural anchor.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye starts at the large yellow header, moves down to the sub-header, and rests on the physical object of the record crate.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Extensive negative space at the top and sides focuses all attention on the central object and text.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Black (background and case panels) providing depth and focus.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Vibrant Yellow (typography) for immediate readability and energy.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Extreme value contrast between the black void and the bright yellow/white elements.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single typeface family used in different weights and sizes for consistency.

candidateDirections.reason: Classic neo-grotesque look with tight spacing capabilities.
Modern alternative with high legibility and similar x-height.
Readily available font that captures the heavy, industrial feel.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-resolution photograph of a black industrial DJ flight case with silver metallic corner reinforcements and a central latch. The case should be open, showing the tops of several vinyl record sleeves inside. The entire object should be set against a seamless, solid black background with studio lighting that highlights the metallic textures.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add bold, sans-serif text in a vibrant process yellow at the top left. The main title should be large and tightly tracked. A secondary line of text should be placed immediately below it in a slightly smaller weight. Ensure no text overlaps the physical object.

verificationChecks: Is the font a heavy, bold sans-serif?
Is the flight case hardware clearly visible and metallic?

adjustableVariables: Color of the text (e.g., neon green or white)
Number of records visible inside the case
mustRedesign: Specific brand logos in the bottom corners
Any specific artist names on the record sleeves

mustAchieve: Realistic metallic reflections on the case

postGenerationChecks: Check for text legibility against the black background.
Ensure the metallic corners look like real hardware, not flat grey shapes.
Verify the yellow color is saturated and punchy.
Confirm the composition remains centered and balanced.
recipe.reuseFormula: Industrial object + Solid Black Background + Bold Yellow Sans-Serif Typography = High-Impact Music Graphic.
